mt-0">Teams &amp; Enterprise</span></div><div class="prose prose-lg max-w-none"><h1 class="text-large mb-8">Team Pricing</h1>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">There are two business plans: Teams and Enterprise (Custom). Teams offers two types of seats: Standard ($40/user/mo) and Premium (5x usage at $120/user/mo).</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Team plans provide additional features like:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Centralized team billing and administration, with usage stats also available via the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/account/teams/admin-api">Admin API</a></li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Team marketplace for internal rules, skills, and plugins</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Agentic code reviews with Bugbot</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Cloud agents and automations with shared team context</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Usage analytics to understand team behavior</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Team-wide privacy mode enforcement</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">SAML/OIDC SSO</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">We recommend Teams for any customer that is happy self-serving. We recommend <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/enterprise">Enterprise</a> for customers that need priority support, pooled usage, invoicing, SCIM, or advanced security controls. <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/contact-sales?source=docs-teams-pricing" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Contact sales</a> to get started.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="how-pricing-works"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-pricing-works" data-heading-base-id="how-pricing-works" aria-label="Copy link to how-pricing-works"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How pricing works</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Teams pricing is based on paid seats and usage. Each paid seat includes monthly usage, and you can continue using Cursor beyond that with on-demand usage.</p>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="seat-types"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#seat-types" data-heading-base-id="seat-types" aria-label="Copy link to seat-types"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Seat types</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Teams has two paid seat types and one free admin-only seat type:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Standard</strong>: $40/user/mo with the standard Teams usage allowance</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Premium</strong>: $120/user/mo with 5x the usage of a Standard seat</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Free</strong>: $0/user/mo for Unpaid Admins who manage the team without Cursor access</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Seat type is separate from role. Members and Admins can have either a Standard or Premium seat. Unpaid Admins don&#x27;t use a paid seat.</p>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="included-usage"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#included-usage" data-heading-base-id="included-usage" aria-label="Copy link to included-usage"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Included usage</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Each paid seat comes with included usage across two pools:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Cursor Models (Cursor Grok 4.6, Grok 4.5, and Composer 2.5)</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Other Models (third-party models)</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Usage is allocated per user based on seat type, does not transfer between team members, and resets at the start of each billing cycle. Third-party Other Models usage is charged at public list API prices plus the Cursor Token Rate. This includes when Auto routes to a third-party model. Cursor Models, including Grok and Composer, are exempt from the Cursor Token Rate.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">The <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/usage" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">usage dashboard</a> tracks included usage separately for:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Cursor Models</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Other Models (third-party models)</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Our <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/enterprise">Enterprise plan</a> offers pooled usage shared between all users in a team. <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/contact-sales?source=docs-teams-pricing" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Get in touch</a> with our team to learn more.</p>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="on-demand-usage"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#on-demand-usage" data-heading-base-id="on-demand-usage" aria-label="Copy link to on-demand-usage"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">On-demand usage</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">On-demand usage allows you to continue using models after included usage is consumed, billed in arrears.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">When a team member consumes all of their included third-party Other Models usage, Cursor switches them to the Cursor Models pool. If they continue using third-party Other Models, or if they fully consume their Cursor Models pool usage, they continue with <strong>on-demand usage</strong> if it is enabled.</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Third-party models are billed monthly at public list API prices plus the Cursor Token Rate</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">First-party Cursor models, including Grok and Composer, are billed monthly at their token rates with no Cursor Token Rate</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">All Auto modes bill at the list price of the model each request is routed to. Third-party models also incur the Cursor Token Rate</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">No interruption in service or quality</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Tracked per user in your admin dashboard (see <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/account/teams/admin-api#get-spending-data">spending data API</a>)</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Can be controlled with spending limits</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">On-demand usage is enabled by default for the Teams plan.</p>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="cursor-token-rate"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#cursor-token-rate" data-heading-base-id="cursor-token-rate" aria-label="Copy link to cursor-token-rate"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Cursor Token Rate</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">The Cursor Token Rate is $0.25 per million tokens and is charged on third-party model requests. This covers:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Custom model execution (Tab, Apply, etc.)</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Infrastructure and processing costs</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">The Cursor Token Rate applies to input tokens, output tokens, and cached tokens on eligible third-party model requests. This includes when Auto routes to a third-party model. This applies to <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/help/models-and-usage/api-keys">BYOK</a> as well. First-party Cursor models, including Grok and Composer, are exempt.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/models-and-pricing#auto-modes">Auto modes</a> for Auto pricing.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="active-seats"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#active-seats" data-heading-base-id="active-seats" aria-label="Copy link to active-seats"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Active seats</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Cursor bills per active paid seat, not pre-allocated seats. Add, remove, upgrade, or downgrade users anytime and billing will adjust based on seat type.</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Adding a member mid-cycle creates a pro-rated charge</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Removing a member who used credits keeps the seat occupied until the cycle ends</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Billing adjustments appear as account credit on a future invoice when applicable</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Your renewal date stays the same</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="spending-controls"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#spending-controls" data-heading-base-id="spending-controls" aria-label="Copy link to spending-controls"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Spending controls</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Teams can configure monthly team-wide spending limits. You can manage these limits through the dashboard. Per-member spend limits are available on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/enterprise">Enterprise</a> plans.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Contact <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">enterprise@cursor.com</code> for volume discounts on larger teams.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="model-pricing"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#model-pricing" data-heading-base-id="model-pricing" aria-label="Copy link to model-pricing"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Model Pricing</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">All prices are per million tokens. Teams are charged at public list API prices plus <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="#cursor-token-rate">Cursor Token Rate</a> for third-party model requests, including when Auto routes to a third-party model.</p>

mt-0">Teams &amp; Enterprise</span></div><div class="prose prose-lg max-w-none"><h1 class="text-large mb-8">Team Pricing</h1>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">There are two business plans: Teams and Enterprise (Custom). Teams offers two types of seats: Standard ($40/user/mo) and Premium (5x usage at $120/user/mo).</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Team plans provide additional features like:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Centralized team billing and administration, with usage stats also available via the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/account/teams/admin-api">Admin API</a></li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Team marketplace for internal rules, skills, and plugins</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Agentic code reviews with Bugbot</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Cloud agents and automations with shared team context</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Usage analytics to understand team behavior</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Team-wide privacy mode enforcement</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">SAML/OIDC SSO</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">We recommend Teams for any customer that is happy self-serving. We recommend <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/enterprise">Enterprise</a> for customers that need priority support, pooled usage, invoicing, SCIM, or advanced security controls. <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/contact-sales?source=docs-teams-pricing" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Contact sales</a> to get started.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="how-pricing-works"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-pricing-works" data-heading-base-id="how-pricing-works" aria-label="Copy link to how-pricing-works"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How pricing works</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Teams pricing is based on paid seats and usage. Each paid seat includes monthly usage, and you can continue using Cursor beyond that with on-demand usage.</p>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="seat-types"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#seat-types" data-heading-base-id="seat-types" aria-label="Copy link to seat-types"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Seat types</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Teams has two paid seat types and one free admin-only seat type:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Standard</strong>: $40/user/mo with the standard Teams usage allowance</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Premium</strong>: $120/user/mo with 5x the usage of a Standard seat</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Free</strong>: $0/user/mo for Unpaid Admins who manage the team without Cursor access</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Seat type is separate from role. Members and Admins can have either a Standard or Premium seat. Unpaid Admins don&#x27;t use a paid seat.</p>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="included-usage"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#included-usage" data-heading-base-id="included-usage" aria-label="Copy link to included-usage"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Included usage</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Each paid seat comes with included usage across two pools:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Cursor Models (Cursor Grok 4.6, Grok 4.5, and Composer 2.5)</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Other Models (third-party models)</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Usage is allocated per user based on seat type, does not transfer between team members, and resets at the start of each billing cycle. Third-party Other Models usage is charged at public list API prices plus the Cursor Token Rate. This includes when Auto routes to a third-party model. Cursor Models, including Grok and Composer, are exempt from the Cursor Token Rate.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">The <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/usage" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">usage dashboard</a> tracks included usage separately for:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Cursor Models</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Other Models (third-party models)</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Our <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/enterprise">Enterprise plan</a> offers pooled usage shared between all users in a team. <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/contact-sales?source=docs-teams-pricing" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Get in touch</a> with our team to learn more.</p>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="on-demand-usage"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#on-demand-usage" data-heading-base-id="on-demand-usage" aria-label="Copy link to on-demand-usage"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">On-demand usage</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">On-demand usage allows you to continue using models after included usage is consumed, billed in arrears.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">When a team member consumes all of their included third-party Other Models usage, Cursor switches them to the Cursor Models pool. If they continue using third-party Other Models, or if they fully consume their Cursor Models pool usage, they continue with <strong>on-demand usage</strong> if it is enabled.</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Third-party models are billed monthly at public list API prices plus the Cursor Token Rate</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">First-party Cursor models, including Grok and Composer, are billed monthly at their token rates with no Cursor Token Rate</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">All Auto modes bill at the list price of the model each request is routed to. Third-party models also incur the Cursor Token Rate</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">No interruption in service or quality</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Tracked per user in your admin dashboard (see <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/account/teams/admin-api#get-spending-data">spending data API</a>)</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Can be controlled with spending limits</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">On-demand usage is enabled by default for the Teams plan.</p>
<h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="cursor-token-rate"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#cursor-token-rate" data-heading-base-id="cursor-token-rate" aria-label="Copy link to cursor-token-rate"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Cursor Token Rate</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">The Cursor Token Rate is $0.25 per million tokens and is charged on third-party model requests. This covers:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Custom model execution (Tab, Apply, etc.)</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Infrastructure and processing costs</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">The Cursor Token Rate applies to input tokens, output tokens, and cached tokens on eligible third-party model requests. This includes when Auto routes to a third-party model. This applies to <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/help/models-and-usage/api-keys">BYOK</a> as well. First-party Cursor models, including Grok and Composer, are exempt.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/models-and-pricing#auto-modes">Auto modes</a> for Auto pricing.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="active-seats"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#active-seats" data-heading-base-id="active-seats" aria-label="Copy link to active-seats"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Active seats</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Cursor bills per active paid seat, not pre-allocated seats. Add, remove, upgrade, or downgrade users anytime and billing will adjust based on seat type.</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Adding a member mid-cycle creates a pro-rated charge</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Removing a member who used credits keeps the seat occupied until the cycle ends</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Billing adjustments appear as account credit on a future invoice when applicable</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Your renewal date stays the same</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="spending-controls"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#spending-controls" data-heading-base-id="spending-controls" aria-label="Copy link to spending-controls"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Spending controls</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Teams can configure monthly team-wide spending limits. You can manage these limits through the dashboard. Per-member spend limits are available on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/enterprise">Enterprise</a> plans.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Contact <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">enterprise@cursor.com</code> for volume discounts on larger teams.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="model-pricing"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#model-pricing" data-heading-base-id="model-pricing" aria-label="Copy link to model-pricing"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Model Pricing</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">All prices are per million tokens. Teams are charged at public list API prices plus <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="#cursor-token-rate">Cursor Token Rate</a> for third-party model requests, including when Auto routes to a third-party model.</p>
